question: Can BRRK-0011 preserve its existing downside authority while allowing a strictly bull-only 0..0.5 V1-scale extra-beta sleeve, and does that remain economically useful after current native Hyperliquid funding accounting?

frozen_inputs.state_model: existing 4-state price-only PCA4 variational HMM, 600-day minimum training, 30-day refit

trend_score.component_transform: tanh(log-price momentum / horizon-scaled daily log-return volatility)

frozen_inputs.p_bad: Exact BRRK-0009 label-free raw-state P(conditional V1 daily mean < 0), posterior-weighted using the strict causal raw-state filter.

only_structural_change.permission: Extra beta may exist only when corrected BRRK core scale is numerically exactly 1.0; any BRRK de-risking below 1.0 has absolute veto authority.
only_structural_change.downside_risk_veto: Extra cannot exceed max(0, safe_total_scale - 1), where safe_total_scale is the largest total V1 scale <=1.50 satisfying the existing 20-day CVaR95 and corrected CDaR95 20% budgets.
only_structural_change.asset_allocation: Uniformly scale the existing frozen V1 vector. No SOL or other asset-specific tilt.

strict_current_router.all_incremental_exposure_above_core: Hyperliquid perp / native funding including incremental BTC

implementation_accounting.historical_spot_fee_basis_slippage: NOT_INVENTED; omitted until legitimate historical/forward evidence exists.

required_validation: Reconstructed corrected BRRK core weights must match persisted BRRK0011_BASELINE weights within 1e-5 max absolute weight error.
Reconstructed strict-core funding equity must match ROUTER-PNL-0005 within $0.05 max absolute equity error.
Report price-only and strict-router funding-aware metrics separately.
prohibited: no SOL-specific or other asset-specific tilt
no change to V1 selection or weights
no p_bad threshold or transformation search
no change to the 20% CVaR/CDaR budget
no choosing among 1.3/1.5/1.75/2.0 after seeing results
no representation of this same-window architecture test as untouched OOS or production promotion evidence
stopping_rule: After the first valid run, do not tune this specification on the same historical window. It may be rejected, or if economically promising, only qualify for a separately preregistered forward-shadow test.
